def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    fund_value = 100_000_000
    current_stock_weight = 0.80
    target_stock_weight = 0.60
    stock_beta = 1.20
    futures_beta = 0.95
    index_level = 1_200
    contract_multiplier = 250

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    stock_value_to_reduce = fund_value * (current_stock_weight - target_stock_weight)
    futures_contract_value = index_level * contract_multiplier
    beta_adjusted_contract_value = futures_contract_value * futures_beta
    number_of_futures = (
        stock_value_to_reduce * stock_beta
    ) / beta_adjusted_contract_value

    # return answer
    return round(number_of_futures, 3)
